sources.title: OpenLearn — Changing priorities: the ABC model
sources.context: UK Open University course; no page update date asserted
sources.sections: Opening paragraph on changing work–life priorities
sources.use: Priorities can change as other demands change.

sources.title: NASA — Technical Assessment
sources.context: U.S. NASA systems engineering reference; no update date asserted
sources.sections: Technical assessment process and periodic status versus corrective assessment
sources.use: Review should inform a corrective decision, beyond reporting status.
sources.limits: Personal review and community maintenance are author analogies. No NASA approval, system qualification, linked handbook/diagram review or human assessment validity.

sources.title: IHI — Model for Improvement
sources.context: Institute for Healthcare Improvement; no update date asserted
sources.sections: Aims, measures, changes and small PDSA tests
sources.use: Small tests can use actual feedback to adapt before wider implementation.
sources.limits: Only overview inspected; testing-changes detail route failed retrieval. No copied worksheet, clinical intervention, causal proof or authority to resolve moral principles.

sources.title: CDC — How to Use the Index
sources.context: U.S. CDC Clear Communication Index; no update date asserted
sources.sections: Audience, communication objective, main message and review
sources.use: Make the audience and intended action clear and check understanding.
sources.limits: No index scoring, public-health validation, actual reader result or CDC endorsement; original cupboard and event-notice materials.

sources.title: W3C WAI — Making Events Accessible
sources.context: International accessibility guidance; no jurisdiction or update date inferred
sources.sections: Accessible materials, initial event planning and participation
sources.use: Plan accessible information and suitable participation modes.
sources.limits: No WCAG or legal certification, automatic equivalence for qualifications, or assumption about an individual based on group membership.

sources.title: University of Edinburgh — What? So what? Now what?
sources.sections: Three reflective questions, action specificity and limitations
sources.use: Separate what happened, its interpretation and a concrete next action.
sources.limits: Original referenced books not inspected; no therapy, validated character scale or authority for optional-role doctrine. That doctrine is canonical curriculum content.
